breakdown.description: Engineering stress is defined with the original area A_0, not the final area A_f.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification continues to use the final cross-sectional area A_f (115 mm²) instead of correcting it to the original cross-sectional area A_0 (130 mm²) as specified in the ground truth. It repeats the original error by defining engineering stress as load divided by final area, and uses the incorrect area value of 115 mm² rather than the correct 130 mm².
